title: Professional Certificate Course in Fundamental Concepts in Marketing L3
description: The aim of this course is to provide learners with a foundational understanding of the key concepts and principles that form the basis of modern marketing.
longDescription: Define marketing principles and concepts. Differentiate between customer needs, wants, and desires. Understand how customer satisfaction contributes to value creation. Explore current and future marketing trends. Apply market planning and the marketing mix to strategic initiatives. The aim of this course is to provide learners with a foundational understanding of the key concepts and principles that form the basis of modern marketing. Learners will gain a comprehensive understanding of the role of marketing in creating customer value, identifying and analyzing customer needs and desires, and developing effective marketing strategies that meet the needs and desires of customers. The course will also cover the latest developments in marketing concepts and practices, including customer satisfaction and value creation, market planning and marketing mix, and current and future trends in marketing. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: Delve into the essentials of marketing, from defining principles and understanding customer distinctions to applying market planning and the marketing mix strategically. This course equips participants with a deep understanding of how customer satisfaction contributes to value creation, ensuring a solid foundation in marketing concepts and practices.
